name: paper_cc_discharge_2C
comment: Select the same cell used for 02a-02b. Discharge at up to 2C to its min_v, log 30 min relaxation, then recharge at up to 2C to its max_v with a 0.02C taper and rest 30 min. Logged every 3 s. Both currents are automatically capped to the selected cell's limits and the EBC ceiling (5 A charge / 20 A discharge); confirm the achieved current in the CSV.
